info.title: Authula API
info.description: Authula API - An open-source authentication solution that scales with you.

get.description: Returns the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) containing the public keys used to verify JWT signatures.
Lists all permissions.

post.description: Creates a new permission.

get.description: Retrieves a permission by its key.
Retrieves a permission by its ID.
Lists all roles.

post.description: Creates a new role.

get.description: Retrieves a role by its name.
Retrieves a role by its ID, including its permissions.
Lists all permissions assigned to a role.

put.description: Replaces all permissions assigned to a role with a new set.

post.description: Assigns a permission to a role.

delete.description: Removes a permission from a role.

get.description: Retrieves all permissions granted to a user through their roles.

post.description: Checks whether a user has all the specified permissions.

get.description: Lists all roles assigned to a user.

put.description: Replaces all roles assigned to a user with a new set.

post.description: Assigns a role to a user.

delete.description: Removes a role from a user.

get.description: Retrieves an account by its ID.
Lists all impersonations.

post.description: Starts an impersonation session as a target user.

get.description: Retrieves an impersonation by its ID.

post.description: Stops an impersonation session and restores the original session.

get.description: Lists all revoked session states.

post.description: Revokes a session.

get.description: Retrieves the state of a session.

post.description: Creates the state for a session.

delete.description: Deletes the state of a session.

patch.description: Updates the state of a session.

get.description: Lists users with cursor-based pagination.

post.description: Creates a new user with the specified attributes.

get.description: Lists all banned user states.
Retrieves a user by their ID.
Lists all accounts for a user.

post.description: Creates a new account for a user.
Bans a user.

get.description: Lists all sessions for a user.
Retrieves the state of a user.

post.description: Creates the state for a user.

delete.description: Deletes the state of a user.

patch.description: Updates the state of a user.

post.description: Unbans a user.

get.description: Lists API keys with pagination, optionally filtered by owner.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the specified owner.
Verifies an API key by its raw value and returns the associated key details.

get.description: Retrieves an API key by its ID.

post.description: Changes the user's password using a reset token
Requests to change the authenticated user's email address
Requests a password reset link to be sent to the user's email
Sends a verification email to the authenticated user
Authenticates a user with email and password
Registers a new user with email and password

get.description: Verifies an email address or processes a password reset token using a verification token

post.summary: Exchange magic link token for session
post.description: Exchanges a verified magic link token for an authenticated user session.
Sends a magic link to the given email address if an account exists. Optionally creates a new account if sign-up is enabled.

get.description: Verifies a magic link token. If a callback_url is provided and trusted, redirects the user with an exchange token appended. Otherwise returns the exchange token in the JSON response.
Retrieves the authenticated user's profile and current session.
Initiates the OAuth2 authorization flow with the specified provider. Returns the provider's authorization URL to redirect the user to.
Handles the OAuth2 callback from the provider. Exchanges the authorization code for tokens, creates or links a user account, and returns the authenticated user and session.
Lists all organizations owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new organization with the authenticated user as the owner.

get.description: Retrieves an organization by its ID.
Lists all invitations for an organization.

post.description: Creates an invitation for a user to join an organization.

get.description: Retrieves a single invitation by its ID.

post.description: Accepts an invitation to join an organization. Optionally redirects if a redirect_url is provided.
Rejects an invitation to join an organization.

get.description: Lists all members of an organization with pagination.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of an organization with the specified role.

get.description: Retrieves an organization member by the user's ID with nested user data.
Retrieves a single organization member by ID with nested user data.

delete.description: Removes a member from an organization.

patch.description: Updates the role of an organization member.

get.description: Lists all teams within an organization.

post.description: Creates a new team within an organization.

get.description: Retrieves a single team by its ID.
Lists all members of a team with pagination.

post.description: Adds a member to a team.

get.description: Retrieves a single team member by ID with nested member and user data.

delete.description: Removes a member from a team.

post.description: Signs out the authenticated user. Optionally sign out a specific session or all sessions.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair.
Disables TOTP two-factor authentication for the authenticated user.
Enables TOTP two-factor authentication for the authenticated user. Returns the TOTP URI and backup codes.
Generates a new set of backup codes for the authenticated user. Previous backup codes are invalidated.

get.description: Returns the current TOTP URI for the authenticated user's authenticator app configuration.

post.description: Verifies a TOTP code from the authenticator app and completes authentication. Requires a pending TOTP cookie set during sign-in.
Verifies a backup code as an alternative to TOTP verification. Completes authentication if the code is valid.

OrganizationInvitationStatus.description: The type of the invitation status
